A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SmokeSVD. Their main texts, equations, figures, tables, and complete supplements support comparison, including matching material moved between the main text and supplement.

before.justification: v1 reports original ScalarFlow and synthetic-smoke reconstruction experiments, quantitative ablations, generalization examples, and re-simulation results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds baseline comparisons, optical-flow measurements, and further generalization examples.

M1.justification: Both retain the physically guided SvDiff synthesizer, multi-frame training, progressive NvRef refinement, density generators, and velocity/inflow estimation. The added Algorithm S2 documents the existing refinement loop rather than introducing a new method component.

E1.justification: v2 adds horizontal-plume and dry-ice evaluation scenarios in Figure 11 and Figure S7. ScalarFlow and synthetic training coverage remain unchanged; the bunny-without-inflow and multi-plume examples already appeared in v1's supplement.

E2.justification: FluidNexus and NeuSmoke become evaluated comparators in v2 Tables 2–3 and Figures 7–8; v1 cited them without these comparisons. This substantially expands comparison against closely related approaches, while retaining the original GlobTrans, NGT, PICT, and PINF comparisons.

E3.justification: New protocols include a five-scene FluidNexus comparison using four non-frontal cameras and several post-processing thresholds, a NeuSmoke comparison using two input views and three evaluation views, and optical-flow measurements over 120 frames. Existing benchmark settings and training procedures are retained.

E4.justification: v2 adds FluidNexus threshold sensitivity comparisons, an optical-flow analysis of temporal consistency, and horizontal-plume/dry-ice generalization cases. Existing component ablations, frame/view-count studies, velocity analyses, and NGT-combination experiments remain, sometimes relocated.

E5.justification: Table S2 newly reports maximum, mean, and standard deviation of optical flow across 120 frames. These are descriptive temporal-variability statistics, not uncertainty across independent runs; neither version reports experimental seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: v2 adds substantial comparative and temporal results while retaining the original quantitative tables. In new Table 2, novel-view PSNR is 23.4393 for SmokeSVD versus 25.3569 for FluidNexus at threshold 0.1, despite SmokeSVD's better input-view scores. New Table 3 reports PSNR 30.0384 versus NeuSmoke's 26.5031 under its two-input-view protocol. These are newly reported comparisons, not improvements over v1 scores.

T1.justification: The Navier–Stokes, diffusion, advection, and loss formulations are substantively retained. Neither version supplies theoretical guarantees or proofs, and the added refinement pseudocode introduces no new theoretical result.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: physically guided side-view synthesis, progressive multi-view refinement, and efficient smoke reconstruction supporting re-simulation. Condensed wording and additional experiments do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: v2 interprets the new comparisons as input-fidelity and threshold-robustness advantages while acknowledging weaker novel-view performance than FluidNexus. It also interprets optical-flow statistics as temporal-consistency evidence and attributes PICT's low mean flow to blurring. The substantive limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds explicit progressive-refinement pseudocode in Algorithm S2. Hardware, training stages, dataset sizes, and density resolutions remain documented as before. v1's promise to release code and sample tests upon acceptance is absent from v2; this does not establish that an available resource was withdrawn.

R1.justification: The cited literature is retained, but v2 develops more specific positioning against NeuSmoke and FluidNexus, emphasizing input fidelity and threshold robustness while conceding FluidNexus's novel-view advantage. This is a limited refinement of comparative positioning rather than an expanded literature review.

P1.justification: v2 extensively condenses and rewrites the abstract, introduction, related work, method explanation, and evaluation narrative. It reorganizes material across the main text and supplement, consolidates references, and changes author and acknowledgement material.

P2.justification: The page template and visual organization change substantially. v2 revises teaser/overview renderings, transposes the refinement comparison, integrates previously deferred figures into the narrative, and moves NGT-combination panels into the supplement. It also adds baseline-comparison tables and figures, generalization panels, and the optical-flow table.

improvement.justification: Direct comparisons with FluidNexus and NeuSmoke address an empirical gap in v1, while temporal analysis and additional generalization cases strengthen validation. The gain is limited by reporting overreach: Table 3 evaluates novel views with two inputs and does not substantiate the accompanying claim of input-view superiority over NeuSmoke. The code-release promise also disappears.
